# MCAP fixtures

One small recording (four channels, 18 messages, three chunks, an attachment, a metadata
record; see `make_mcap.py`), written several ways and damaged several ways. Every file is
generated by `make_mcap.py` and checked byte for byte by `tests/unit/adapters/test_mcap_fixtures.py`.
`oracle.json` is what the official `mcap` reader (1.5.0, fetched by `uv` for that run only, never a
project dependency) reads from each file, with `uv run python tests/fixtures/mcap/make_mcap.py
--oracle`: in file order (`streamed`) and through the summary (`indexed`). The adapter's tests
compare their rows with it.

| File | What it is | What the adapter must do |
|---|---|---|
| `robot.mcap` | zstd chunks, Message Indexes, full summary | plan from the summary alone; the golden package (`tests/golden/mcap`) |
| `robot_lz4.mcap` | the same, lz4 chunks | the same rows |
| `robot_plain.mcap` | the same, uncompressed chunks | the same rows |
| `unchunked.mcap` | messages at top level, summary without chunk indexes | scan; the same rows, one-step locators |
| `no_summary.mcap` | chunked, footer declares no summary | scan; declarations cited inside chunks |
| `no_message_index.mcap` | chunk indexes without Message Index offsets | count each chunk by decompressing it |
| `empty.mcap` | a header, statistics of zero, nothing else | a run and a clock, no streams |
| `unknown_encoding.mcap` | a fifth channel with an unregistered schema and message encoding | keep both as declared, with findings |
| `truncated.mcap` | `robot_plain.mcap` cut inside its last chunk | `truncated`, and the cut chunk's whole messages read (the official reader stops before them) |
| `bad_crc.mcap` | chunk 1's CRC wrong | `crc_mismatch`; chunks 0 and 2 land |
| `bad_summary_crc.mcap` | the summary's CRC wrong | `summary_unusable`; scan; every message (the official reader does not check it) |
| `overlapping_index.mcap` | chunk index 1 points at chunk 0, CRC recomputed | `index_invalid`; scan; 18 messages (the official reader reads 19) |
| `lying_index.mcap` | chunk 0's `/imu` Message Index and the statistics both omit one message | `message_count_mismatch` and `index_mismatch`; that message has no row |
| `unknown_compression.mcap` | chunk 1 declares `brotli` | `unknown_compression`; chunks 0 and 2 land |

The compressed bytes depend on the pinned `zstandard` and `lz4`; an upgrade may change them (never
what they decompress to), and then the files are regenerated. Tests also build hostile files at
test time: cuts at many offsets, random byte flips, out-of-range times, undeclared and redeclared
channels, invalid UTF-8, private records.
